facts.statement: Spondylosoma is a genus of avemetatarsalian archosaurs belonging to the clade Aphanosauria.
facts.quote: Spondylosoma (meaning "vertebra body") is a genus of avemetatarsalian archosaur, belonging to the clade Aphanosauria

facts.statement: Spondylosoma fossils are found in the Middle Triassic (late Ladinian age) Lower Santa Maria Formation in Brazil.
facts.quote: from the Middle Triassic (late Ladinian age) Lower Santa Maria Formation in Paleorrota Geopark, Brazil

facts.statement: Friedrich von Huene established the genus based on a fragmentary postcranial skeleton housed at the University of Tübingen.
facts.quote: Friedrich von Huene based the genus on a fragmentary postcranial skeleton held at the University of Tübingen

facts.statement: The holotype skeleton consists of two teeth, cervical and dorsal vertebrae, sacral vertebrae, scapulae, and partial limb bones.
facts.quote: This skeleton includes two teeth, two cervical vertebrae, four dorsal vertebrae, three sacral vertebrae, scapulae, part of a humerus, part of a femur, and part of a pubis

facts.statement: Von Huene originally classified Spondylosoma as a prosauropod.
facts.quote: At the time, he thought it was a prosauropod

facts.statement: Scientists have debated whether Spondylosoma is a basal dinosaur, a thecodont, or another type of basal archosaur.
facts.quote: Authors went back and forth on the question, considering it either as a basal dinosaur, or as a "thecodont" or other basal archosaur

facts.statement: In 2000, Peter Galton argued that Spondylosoma lacks dinosaurian traits and is likely a rauisuchian related to rauisuchids.
facts.quote: In 2000, Peter Galton noted that it lacks dinosaurian characteristics and was probably a rauisuchian more closely related to rauisuchids

facts.statement: In 2004, Max Langer disputed Galton's view, suggesting Spondylosoma might be a basal dinosaur related to herrerasaurs while leaving rauisuchian affinities open.
facts.quote: in 2004 Max Langer disputed this and included Spondylosoma as a possible basal dinosaur similar to the herrerasaurs (but did not firmly rule out rauisuchian affinities)

facts.statement: Sterling Nesbitt placed Spondylosoma in Archosauria incertae sedis in his 2009 thesis due to insufficient characters to place it in Pseudosuchia or Ornithodira.
facts.quote: In his 2009 thesis on archosaur evolution, Sterling Nesbitt placed Spondylosoma at Archosauria incertae sedis

facts.statement: Redescriptions of related taxa like Teleocrater led to the referral of Spondylosoma to the new clade Aphanosauria.
facts.quote: The redescription of Teleocrater revealed numerous similarities between Spondylosoma and a few other Triassic taxa leading to their referral to a new clade of archosaurs, Aphanosauria

facts.statement: Spondylosoma lived during the middle Triassic, approximately 230 million years ago, in the Ladinian stage.
facts.quote: que vivió a mediados del período Triásico, hace aproximadamente 230 millones de años, en el Ladiniense

facts.statement: Fossils of Spondylosoma were found in the lower part of the Santa Maria Formation in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil.
facts.quote: Encontrado en la parte más baja de la Formación Santa María en el estado de Rio Grande do Sul Brasil

facts.statement: Spondylosoma lived between 241.464 and 237 million years ago during the Ladinian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Ladinian to Ladinian (241.464 to 237 million years ago)
